page.overview:
Who is Countess Labinsky?

Countess Labinsky is a henchman of Hugo Drax's. She is portrayed by French actress Catherine Serre.

Countess Labinsky was first seen with Lady Victoria Devon when Hugo Drax played for them on the piano in his château. They were introduced to James Bond shortly thereafter. Next she was seen on the secret base near the River Tapirapé and afterwards aboard Drax's Space Station. She was one of Drax's "perfect women", tasked with repopulating the human race. It is likely that she died when the space station exploded.
